description:
💼 Brand Introduction: TOTPawHug is a family-focused apparel brand that celebrates the special bond between humans and their furry companions. We offer stylish, comfortable, and high-quality clothing designed to bring joy to pet lovers everywhere. Our collections combine fun designs with the love of pets, making our products the go-to choice for those who want to show off their paw-some pride. 🌟🐾

🛍️ Product Description: Our collections include a variety of apparel designed for both pets and their owners. From cozy tees and hoodies to fun accessories, each piece is crafted with care and style. We also offer unique designs that resonate with the love of pets, and our products are perfect for families, dog moms, and pet enthusiasts who want to make a statement.

✨ Unique Selling Point (USP): TOTPawHug is not just a clothing brand; it’s a lifestyle that celebrates the deep connection between people and their pets. Our high-quality materials, thoughtful designs, and commitment to comfort set us apart. Affiliates can promote a brand that not only offers fashionable apparel but also connects deeply with the values of pet lovers. 🐾💖

💰 Payment Terms: Affiliates earn a competitive commission for every sale referred:

  • 6% on total referral sales.
  • 12% on sales over $150. Payments are processed monthly, ensuring that affiliates get rewarded for their efforts in a timely manner.

📈 Other Information:

  • Cookie Duration: 30 days, so you get credit for sales generated even after the first visit!
  • Marketing materials and support are provided to help you maximize your affiliate success.
  • Join a growing community of TOTPawHug ambassadors and earn while spreading love for the brand! 🐕👚
